security_audit.summary: The reviewed skill is prompt-only documentation for Exa search workflows. The static findings are false positives: a Markdown code fence and a GitHub reference link do not execute commands or make network requests.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 17 is a Markdown fenced bash block for an installation example, not executable skill code. The repository contains only SKILL.md and no script that runs this command automatically.
The hardcoded URL is a documentation link to a GitHub repository for examples. It is not a network request made by the skill and does not transmit user data.

content.user_title: Run Semantic Research with Exa Search
content.value_statement: General web search can miss conceptually related sources when keywords differ. This skill guides Exa API workflows for semantic search, similar content discovery, and structured research.
actual_capabilities: Guides semantic and embeddings-based search workflows with Exa.
Supports finding pages and documents similar to a given source.
Frames searches by categories such as companies, people, and research papers.
Helps structure research results into themes, evidence, and next steps.
Reminds users to configure the Exa API key through environment variables.
limitations: Requires Exa API access and a configured API key.
Does not include executable integration code or an API client.
Depends on the AI tool environment for any live search execution.
Points users to an external GitHub repository for detailed examples.

use_cases.title: Find Competitive Signals
use_cases.description: Search company and people categories to collect relevant market sources and summarize major themes.

use_cases.title: Build Research Briefs
use_cases.description: Use semantic queries to find papers, articles, and supporting sources for a structured evidence brief.

use_cases.title: Discover Related Content
use_cases.description: Find pages similar to a reference article and compare their audience, angle, and usefulness.

prompt_templates.title: Find Background Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to find authoritative sources about [topic]. Group the results by theme and explain why each source matters.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Similar Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to find pages similar to [URL or article title]. Compare topic overlap, audience, and practical usefulness.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Market Segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to search company and people categories for [market]. Summarize key players, recent signals, and source quality.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search for semantic searches on [research question]. Create search variants, rank evidence quality, note gaps, and propose follow-up searches.

output_examples.input: Find similar content for an article about usage-based pricing.
output: A grouped list of related pricing articles and product essays.
A short explanation of how each source overlaps with the reference article.
A note on which sources are strongest for strategy, examples, or implementation.

output_examples.input: Research companies building AI search tools for developers.
output: A concise market brief organized by company, product focus, and target user.
Relevant source links grouped by company and recency.
Suggested follow-up searches for missing competitors or technical details.

best_practices: Configure the Exa API key through environment variables before use.
State the topic, audience, and desired source types in each prompt.
Ask for relevance reasoning, source grouping, and follow-up search gaps.
anti_patterns: Do not paste secrets or private customer data into research prompts.
Do not treat search results as verified without checking source credibility.
Do not request broad searches without a topic, category, or evaluation goal.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides semantic search, similar content discovery, and structured research workflows using the Exa API.

faq.question: Do I need an Exa API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects Exa API access and recommends configuring the key through environment variables.

faq.question: Does the skill include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains documentation only and does not include scripts or an API client.

faq.question: Can it find content similar to a page?
faq.answer: Yes, when Exa access is available. The skill is designed for similar content discovery.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How should I check the results?
faq.answer: Review source credibility, publication context, and relevance before using results in decisions.
